label: 71-review-a
scope: the 24 skills named in the launch message, judged against state/briefs/review.md and every point of state/briefs/context-71.md in order, against docs/fold/plan.json and the pre-fold sources at c468ad2^
method: description (context-71 point 1): read all 24 against their folded source lists in docs/fold/plan.json; checked every folded subject is findable in the description and looked for clauses that fire outside the skill's scope

coherence (point 2): resolved every skill name and every references/<file>.md pointer in each skill.json (body and folded) against .claude/skills/ and the skill's own references/ directory; verified every 'X already states F-nnn' row resolves to a target that carries that id (0 failures)

duplication (point 3): normalised-text similarity between each body row and every folded row of the same kind, and between every pair of bodies, reporting only pairs where neither side names the other

lost content (point 4): compared each target against `git show c468ad2^:.claude/skills/<source>/skill.json` for all 24 targets, row by row; the 8 rows dropped with no replacement were checked against kb/ceremonies/71-polish-a.json and 71-source-b.json and each is recorded there as a deletion, so no lost-content finding is raised
definition of done (point 5): resolved every path each criterion names, ran all 24 criteria once, and compared exit code and output with the recorded expected / measured_run

ordinary review (point 6): re-implemented the quote check over body and folded rows against kb/{facts,target-facts,reference-facts,research,decisions,architecture,entities,edges,ledger}.jsonl; scanned every references/*.md for product names outside an Adapters section; ran tools/validate_skills.py --only per skill and tools/check_adapter_pairs.py

findings.evidence: Row text 'Every unit of work must be retried three times before it is reported as failed.' is origin=sourced on F-b1-02 with quote 'The core imports interfaces, never implementations'. The quote is verbatim in F-b1-02 (so validate_skills.py passes it) but F-b1-02 is design rule 1 about the core importing interfaces; it says nothing about retries, and no record in kb/ carries a three-retry rule. The row is an invented platform policy wearing someone else's citation, and it also contradicts cap-durable-execution and seam-dispatch, which put retry under the step's idempotency key and the stop-reason vocabulary, not a fixed count.
findings.fix: Delete the row. If a retry policy is wanted, research it and land it in cap-durable-execution as origin=proposed with its own research record.

findings.evidence: Row text 'A criterion nothing can fail is not a criterion, so every gate carries a breakage.' is origin=sourced on F-part-c-04 under the same verbatim quote agentic-stack and build-skill-authoring already use, and it restates the discipline build-evidence owns (the criterion/breakage/measured-run triple) without naming build-evidence or agentic-stack. validate_skills.py --only cap-idempotency reports exactly this as two restatement warnings, and tools/final_acceptance.py shows stick T-t9-03 (validator reports zero warnings) failing at '0 errors, 2 warnings' because of it.
findings.fix: Delete the row; cap-idempotency's definition of done already carries a breakage, and build-evidence states the rule. If the point is wanted here, rewrite it to name build-evidence rather than re-cite F-part-c-04.

findings.evidence: The criterion 'python3 tools/check_ceremony.py kb/ceremonies/ceremony-01-review.json kb/ceremonies/ceremony-01-improve.json' was run once for this review: it exits 1 with 'findings_checked=7, unresolved=0, duplicated=0, missing_files=11, unknown_finding_ids=0'. This skill's gate is red today.

findings.evidence: core-components folds five components and five implement facets, but took only core-document-implement's gate: 'bash harness/document-validation/test.sh && python3 harness/document-validation/conformance.py --adapter dryrun --adapter second'. The gates the other four implement facets named are no longer run by this skill: harness/core-graph (with its --cross-store run), harness/dispatch (planner, judge) and harness/provenance + harness/state-persistence (ledger). harness/core-graph is now named by no skill's definition of done at all, so the Graph's conformance suite gates nothing.
